library(shiny) library(shinyWidgets) library(bslib) library(dplyr) library(plotly) library(leaflet) library(sf) library(roadcrashVIC) year_range <- range(vic_crashes$year) month_starts <- seq( as.Date(format(min(vic_crashes$accident_date), "%Y-%m-01")), max(vic_crashes$accident_date), by = "month" ) # Default "My area" period: the last 12 months area_default_months <- c(month_starts[length(month_starts) - 11], max(month_starts)) measure_choices <- c("Crashes" = "crashes", "Killed or seriously injured (KSI)" = "ksi", "Deaths" = "fatalities") scale_choices <- c("Count" = "count", "Per 100k residents" = "per_100k", "Per 1,000 crashes" = "per_1000") when_choices <- c("Month" = "month", "Day of the week" = "day_of_week", "Hour of the day" = "hour") # Labels for charts measure_labels <- c(crashes = "Crashes", ksi = "KSI", fatalities = "Deaths") scale_labels <- c(count = "", per_100k = " per 100k residents", per_1000 = " per 1,000 crashes") measure_words <- c(crashes = "crashes", ksi = "KSI", fatalities = "deaths") # Edges of Victoria, to bound the maps vic_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(vic_lga) # Colour of crash points by severity severity_pal <- colorFactor(c("#7f0000", "#e34a33", "#fdbb84"), levels = levels(vic_crashes$severity)) # Popup text of a crash on the map crash_popup <- function(d){ # "2 pedestrians", "1 pedestrian", or "" when the count is 0 count_text <- function(n, word, plural = word) ifelse(n == 0, "", paste(n, ifelse(n == 1, word, plural))) # For each crash, join its non-empty pieces with commas join_parts <- function(...) apply(cbind(...), 1, function(x) paste(x[x != ""], collapse = ", ")) # Plain wording for the light condition and the speed limit light_text <- c( "Day" = "daylight", "Dusk/Dawn" = "dusk or dawn", "Dark Street lights on" = "dark, street lights on", "Dark Street lights off" = "dark, street lights off", "Dark No street lights" = "dark, no street lights", "Dark Street lights unknown" = "dark, street lighting unknown" ) speed <- as.character(d$speed_zone) speed <- ifelse(speed == "Off road", "Off-road location", ifelse(speed == "Other", "Other speed limit", paste(speed, "speed limit"))) title <- paste0("", d$severity, ": ", tolower(d$accident_type), "") date <- paste0( # in English on any computer d$day_of_week, ", ", as.integer(format(d$accident_date, "%d")), " ", month.abb[as.integer(format(d$accident_date, "%m"))], " ", format(d$accident_date, "%Y") ) when_where <- paste0( date, ", ", sprintf("%02dh", d$hour), " - ", tools::toTitleCase(tolower(coalesce(d$road_full_name, "Unknown road"))), ", ", tools::toTitleCase(tolower(d$lga_name)) ) conditions <- paste0( coalesce(speed, "Unknown speed limit"), " - ", coalesce(unname(light_text[d$light_condition]), "light unknown") ) people <- paste0( count_text(d$total_persons, "person", "people"), " involved: ", join_parts( count_text(d$fatality, "killed"), count_text(d$seriousinjury, "seriously injured"), count_text(d$otherinjury, "with other injuries") ) ) users <- join_parts( count_text(d$no_of_vehicles, "vehicle", "vehicles"), count_text(d$pedestrian, "pedestrian", "pedestrians"), count_text(d$bicyclist, "cyclist", "cyclists"), count_text(d$motorcyclist, "motorcyclist", "motorcyclists") ) paste(title, when_where, conditions, people, users, sep = "
") } # Metric in the chosen scale scaled_value <- function(d, measure, scale, population){ if (scale == "count") value <- d[[measure]] if (scale == "per_100k") value <- 1e5 * d[[measure]] / population if (scale == "per_1000") value <- d[[paste0(measure, "_per_1000_crashes")]] value } # Number as text: whole for counts, one decimal for rates number_text <- function(x, scale){ digits <- if (scale == "count") 0 else 1 format(round(x, digits), big.mark = ",", nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE) # no padding spaces } # Hover label: "January", "Monday" or "17h" when_text <- function(when, by){ if (by == "month") return(month.name[as.integer(when)]) if (by == "hour") return(sprintf("%02dh", when)) as.character(when) } # Value box number box_value <- function(d, measure, scale){ if (scale == "per_1000" && (measure == "crashes" || sum(d$crashes) == 0)) return("-") # always 1,000, or no crashes count <- d[[measure]] if (scale == "count") value <- sum(count) # total over the years if (scale == "per_100k") value <- 1e5 * sum(count) / sum(d$population) # average yearly rate if (scale == "per_1000") value <- 1000 * sum(count) / sum(d$crashes) number_text(value, scale) } # Value box title box_title <- function(name, scale){ if (scale == "count") return(name) paste0(name, " (", trimws(scale_labels[[scale]]), ")") } ui <- page_navbar( id = "main_nav", theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "cosmo", primary = "#0d3b66"), title = "Victoria Road Crash Explorer", fillable = FALSE, # let the page scroll header = div( class = "app-intro", includeCSS("styles.css"), # Shinylive only: load plotly and crosstalk with the page, otherwise charts drawn # together at startup stay empty (known bug: github.com/posit-dev/r-shinylive/issues/124) if (R.version$os == "emscripten") tagList( tags$script(src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/rstudio/crosstalk@v1.2.2/inst/www/js/crosstalk.min.js"), tags$script(src = "https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.25.2.min.js") ), p( class = "mb-1", strong(paste0( "How have road crashes in Victoria changed since ", year_range[1], "? ", "Where do most crashes happen, when are they most frequent, and which road users are most vulnerable?" )) ), p( paste0( "Road crashes resulting in injury or death recorded by Victoria Police from ", year_range[1], " to ", year_range[2], ", for members of the public to explore across Victoria and in their local area" ) ) ), nav_panel( "Victoria", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( sliderInput( "vic_years", "Choose a period to analyse:", min = year_range[1], max = year_range[2], value = year_range, step = 1, sep = "" ) |> tagAppendAttributes(`data-grid-snap` = "true", .cssSelector = "input"), # one tick per year selectInput( "vic_measure", "Choose a metric to analyse:", choices = measure_choices ), selectInput( "vic_scale", "Show results as:", choices = scale_choices ), helpText( "Definitions of each metric and scale, and notes on the data, are in the", actionLink("vic_go_about", "About"), "tab" ) ), layout_column_wrap( width = 1/3, value_box(title = textOutput("vic_crashes_title"), value = textOutput("vic_crashes_box")), value_box(title = textOutput("vic_ksi_title"), value = textOutput("vic_ksi_box")), value_box(title = textOutput("vic_deaths_title"), value = textOutput("vic_deaths_box")) ), card( full_screen = TRUE, height = 500, card_header("How has it changed?"), helpText("Each point is one year; a rising line means the chosen metric increased compared with earlier years"), checkboxInput("vic_index", "Compare with population growth (first year = 100)", width = "100%"), plotlyOutput("vic_trend") ), layout_column_wrap( width = 1/2, height = 500, card( full_screen = TRUE, card_header("When do crashes happen most?"), helpText("Taller bars mark the times with higher values"), selectInput("vic_when", NULL, choices = when_choices, width = "200px"), plotlyOutput("vic_when_chart") ), card( full_screen = TRUE, card_header("Who is the most vulnerable road user?"), helpText("Select \"Per 1,000 crashes\" to compare severity across road users"), plotlyOutput("vic_vulnerable_chart"), card_footer("Note: The same crash can appear in more than one bar") ) ), card( full_screen = TRUE, height = 700, card_header("Where do crashes happen most?"), helpText("Darker areas have higher values of the chosen metric; grey areas have no value"), leafletOutput("vic_map", height = 600) ) ) ), nav_panel( "My area", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( selectizeInput( "area_lga", "Choose one or more LGAs to analyse (up to 15):", choices = setNames(sort(vic_lga$lga_name), tools::toTitleCase(tolower(sort(vic_lga$lga_name)))), multiple = TRUE, options = list(maxItems = 15, plugins = list("remove_button")) ), actionButton("area_clear_lga", "Clear LGAs", class = "btn-primary"), airMonthpickerInput( "area_months", "Choose a period to analyse:", range = TRUE, toggleSelected = FALSE, # allow a single month value = area_default_months, minDate = min(month_starts), maxDate = max(month_starts), dateFormat = "MMM yyyy", addon = "none" ), selectInput( "area_measure", "Choose a metric to analyse:", choices = measure_choices ), selectInput( "area_scale", "Show results as:", choices = c("Count" = "count", "Per 1,000 crashes" = "per_1000") ), selectInput( "area_road_user", "Show crashes involving:", choices = c("All road users" = "all", "Pedestrians" = "pedestrian", "Cyclists" = "cyclist", "Motorcyclists" = "motorcyclist") ), helpText( p("Selecting many LGAs or a long period may result in slower loading times"), p("Rates per 100k residents are not available in this tab, because population figures are only published yearly"), p("The map and top roads show only the crashes matching the chosen metric (crashes, KSI or deaths)"), p("Selecting a road user shows the crashes involving them; it does not show how many of them were injured") ) ), textOutput("area_missing_note"), layout_column_wrap( width = 1/3, value_box(title = textOutput("area_crashes_title"), value = textOutput("area_crashes_box")), value_box(title = textOutput("area_ksi_title"), value = textOutput("area_ksi_box")), value_box(title = textOutput("area_deaths_title"), value = textOutput("area_deaths_box")) ), layout_columns( col_widths = c(7, 5), card( full_screen = TRUE, height = 700, card_header("Where have crashes happened?"), helpText("Each point is one crash, coloured by severity; circles group nearby crashes"), leafletOutput("area_map", height = 600) ), card( full_screen = TRUE, height = 700, card_header(textOutput("area_roads_title")), tableOutput("area_top_roads"), card_footer("Note: This is not a ranking of the most dangerous roads") ) ), layout_column_wrap( width = 1/2, height = 500, card( full_screen = TRUE, card_header("When do crashes happen most?"), helpText("Taller bars mark the times with higher values"), selectInput("area_when", NULL, choices = when_choices, width = "200px"), plotlyOutput("area_when_chart"), card_footer(textOutput("area_when_note")) # hidden when empty (styles.css) ), card( full_screen = TRUE, card_header("Who is the most vulnerable road user?"), helpText("Select \"Per 1,000 crashes\" to compare severity across road users"), plotlyOutput("area_vulnerable_chart"), card_footer("Note: The same crash can appear in more than one bar") ) ) ) ), nav_panel( "About", markdown(readLines("about.md")) # text in inst/app/about.md ) ) server <- function(input, output, session){ # "About" tab observeEvent(input$vic_go_about, nav_select("main_nav", "About")) # "Victoria" tab ## Crashes in the selected years vic_data <- reactive( vic_crashes |> filter_crashes( start_date = paste0(input$vic_years[1], "-01-01"), end_date = paste0(input$vic_years[2], "-12-31") ) ) ## Yearly summary vic_summary_year <- reactive( crash_rates(vic_data(), vic_population, by = "year") ) ## Residents over the selected years vic_population_total <- reactive( sum(vic_summary_year()$population) ) ## No charts for crashes per 1,000 crashes vic_check <- reactive( validate(need( !(input$vic_measure == "crashes" & input$vic_scale == "per_1000"), "Crashes per 1,000 crashes are always 1,000: choose KSI or deaths" )) ) ## Axis and legend label vic_label <- reactive( paste0(measure_labels[[input$vic_measure]], scale_labels[[input$vic_scale]]) ) ## Unit in the hover text vic_unit <- reactive( paste0(measure_words[[input$vic_measure]], scale_labels[[input$vic_scale]]) ) ## "When?": one value per month/day/hour vic_when_data <- reactive({ d <- summarise_crashes(vic_data(), by = input$vic_when) data.frame( when = d[[input$vic_when]], value = scaled_value(d, input$vic_measure, input$vic_scale, vic_population_total()) ) }) ## "Who?": one value per road user vic_who_data <- reactive({ d <- summarise_vulnerable(vic_data()) data.frame( road_user = d$road_user, value = scaled_value(d, input$vic_measure, input$vic_scale, vic_population_total()) ) }) ## Map: one value per LGA vic_map_data <- reactive({ d <- crash_rates(vic_data(), vic_population, by = "lga_name") d$value <- scaled_value(d, input$vic_measure, input$vic_scale, d$population) # No rate per resident for the unincorporated area d$value[d$lga_name == "UNINCORPORATED VIC" & input$vic_scale == "per_100k"] <- NA left_join(vic_lga, d, by = "lga_name") }) ## First row: value boxes output$vic_crashes_box <- renderText(box_value(vic_summary_year(), "crashes", input$vic_scale)) output$vic_ksi_box <- renderText(box_value(vic_summary_year(), "ksi", input$vic_scale)) output$vic_deaths_box <- renderText(box_value(vic_summary_year(), "fatalities", input$vic_scale)) output$vic_crashes_title <- renderText(box_title("Crashes", input$vic_scale)) output$vic_ksi_title <- renderText(box_title("KSI", input$vic_scale)) output$vic_deaths_title <- renderText(box_title("Deaths", input$vic_scale)) ## Second row: time trend output$vic_trend <- renderPlotly({ vic_check() d <- vic_summary_year() value <- scaled_value(d, input$vic_measure, input$vic_scale, d$population) trend <- data.frame(year = d$year, value = value, series = measure_labels[[input$vic_measure]]) trend$text <- paste(number_text(value, input$vic_scale), vic_unit()) # Index: values and population, first year = 100 if (input$vic_index) { trend$value <- 100 * trend$value / trend$value[1] population <- data.frame(year = d$year, value = 100 * d$population / d$population[1], series = "Population") trend <- rbind(trend[names(population)], population) trend$text <- paste0(trend$series, " index: ", round(trend$value, 1)) } plot_ly( trend, x = ~year, y = ~value, color = ~series, colors = setNames(c("#0d3b66", "#e69f00"), c(measure_labels[[input$vic_measure]], "Population")), type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", text = ~text, hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{text}" ) |> layout( xaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = "Year", dtick = 1), # fixedrange: no zoom yaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = if (input$vic_index) "Index (first year = 100)" else vic_label()), showlegend = input$vic_index, legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = 1.12, itemclick = FALSE, itemdoubleclick = FALSE) ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE) }) ## Third row: "When?" + "Who?" output$vic_when_chart <- renderPlotly({ vic_check() plot_ly( vic_when_data(), x = ~when, y = ~value, type = "bar", marker = list(color = "#0d3b66"), hovertext = ~paste0(when_text(when, input$vic_when), ": ", number_text(value, input$vic_scale)), hovertemplate = paste0("%{hovertext} ", vic_unit(), "") ) |> layout( xaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = names(when_choices)[when_choices == input$vic_when]), yaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = vic_label()) ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE) }) output$vic_vulnerable_chart <- renderPlotly({ vic_check() d <- vic_who_data() all <- d$value[d$road_user == "All crashes"] plot_ly( d[d$road_user != "All crashes", ], x = ~value, y = ~road_user, type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = "#0d3b66"), hovertext = ~number_text(value, input$vic_scale), hovertemplate = paste0("%{y}: %{hovertext} ", vic_unit(), "") ) |> layout( title = list(text = paste0("All crashes: ", number_text(all, input$vic_scale), " ", vic_unit(), ""), x = 0.02, font = list(size = 14)), xaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = vic_label()), yaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = "") ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE) }) ## Fourth row: map output$vic_map <- renderLeaflet({ vic_check() d <- vic_map_data() pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = d$value) leaflet(d, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 6)) |> addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |> fitBounds(vic_bounds[["xmin"]], vic_bounds[["ymin"]], vic_bounds[["xmax"]], vic_bounds[["ymax"]]) |> setMaxBounds(vic_bounds[["xmin"]], vic_bounds[["ymin"]], vic_bounds[["xmax"]], vic_bounds[["ymax"]]) |> addPolygons( fillColor = ~pal(value), fillOpacity = 0.8, weight = 1, label = ~paste0( tools::toTitleCase(tolower(lga_name)), ": ", ifelse(is.na(value), "no value", format(round(value, 1), big.mark = ",")) ) ) |> addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~value, title = vic_label(), na.label = "No value", opacity=0.8) }) # Shinylive can draw the map before its card has its final size: # fit Victoria again once, when the map has loaded observeEvent(input$vic_map_zoom, once = TRUE, { leafletProxy("vic_map") |> fitBounds(vic_bounds[["xmin"]], vic_bounds[["ymin"]], vic_bounds[["xmax"]], vic_bounds[["ymax"]]) }) # "My area" tab ## "Clear LGAs" button observeEvent(input$area_clear_lga, { updateSelectizeInput(session, "area_lga", selected = character(0)) }) ## Last day of the period's last month area_end <- reactive({ req(length(input$area_months) == 2) # wait until both months are picked seq(as.Date(input$area_months[2]), by = "month", length.out = 2)[2] - 1 # first day of next month, minus one day }) ## Crashes in the selected LGAs and months area_data <- reactive({ validate(need(input$area_lga, "Choose at least one LGA")) vic_crashes |> filter_crashes(start_date = input$area_months[1], end_date = area_end()) |> filter(lga_name %in% input$area_lga) }) ## Road user filter (all outputs except "Who?") area_user_data <- reactive({ d <- area_data() if (input$area_road_user == "pedestrian") d <- filter(d, involves_pedestrian) if (input$area_road_user == "cyclist") d <- filter(d, involves_cyclist) if (input$area_road_user == "motorcyclist") d <- filter(d, involves_motorcyclist) d }) ## Summary of the whole selection area_summary_total <- reactive( summarise_crashes(area_user_data(), by = character(0)) ) ## Metric filter (map and top roads) area_map_data <- reactive({ d <- area_user_data() if (input$area_measure == "ksi") d <- filter(d, severity != "Other injury accident") if (input$area_measure == "fatalities") d <- filter(d, severity == "Fatal accident") validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No crashes match this selection")) d }) ## No charts for crashes per 1,000 crashes area_check <- reactive( validate(need( !(input$area_measure == "crashes" & input$area_scale == "per_1000"), "Crashes per 1,000 crashes are always 1,000: choose KSI or deaths" )) ) ## Axis label area_label <- reactive( paste0(measure_labels[[input$area_measure]], scale_labels[[input$area_scale]]) ) ## Unit in the hover text area_unit <- reactive( paste0(measure_words[[input$area_measure]], scale_labels[[input$area_scale]]) ) ## Note above the value boxes output$area_missing_note <- renderText({ d <- filter_crashes(vic_crashes, start_date = input$area_months[1], end_date = area_end()) missing <- 100 * mean(is.na(d$lga_name)) if (missing >= 3) paste0("Note: ", round(missing), "% of crashes in this period have no recorded location and are not included") }) ## First row: value boxes output$area_crashes_box <- renderText(box_value(area_summary_total(), "crashes", input$area_scale)) output$area_ksi_box <- renderText(box_value(area_summary_total(), "ksi", input$area_scale)) output$area_deaths_box <- renderText(box_value(area_summary_total(), "fatalities", input$area_scale)) output$area_crashes_title <- renderText(box_title("Crashes", input$area_scale)) output$area_ksi_title <- renderText(box_title("KSI", input$area_scale)) output$area_deaths_title <- renderText(box_title("Deaths", input$area_scale)) ## Second row: map + top roads output$area_map <- renderLeaflet({ d <- area_map_data() hover <- paste0( "", d$day_of_week, ", ", format(d$accident_date, "%d/%m/%Y"), ": ", d$severity, "", "
(click for additional details)" ) outlines <- filter(vic_lga, lga_name %in% input$area_lga) box <- sf::st_bbox(outlines) leaflet(d, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 6)) |> addTiles() |> fitBounds(box[["xmin"]], box[["ymin"]], box[["xmax"]], box[["ymax"]]) |> setMaxBounds(vic_bounds[["xmin"]], vic_bounds[["ymin"]], vic_bounds[["xmax"]], vic_bounds[["ymax"]]) |> addPolygons(data = outlines, fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2) |> addCircleMarkers( lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude, radius = 6, stroke = TRUE, # white outline color = "white", weight = 1, opacity = 1, fillColor = ~severity_pal(severity), fillOpacity = 0.9, label = lapply(hover, HTML), # read the and
tags in each label popup = crash_popup(d), popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 500), clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(maxClusterRadius = 40, spiderfyDistanceMultiplier = 2) ) |> addLegend(pal = severity_pal, values = ~severity, title = "Severity", opacity=0.9) }) output$area_roads_title <- renderText( paste0("Roads with the most ", measure_words[[input$area_measure]], " (top 10)") ) output$area_top_roads <- renderTable({ d <- area_map_data() |> filter(!is.na(road_full_name), road_full_name != "UNNAMED") |> summarise_crashes(by = c("road_full_name", "lga_name")) d$value <- d[[input$area_measure]] # sort by the chosen metric, then by crashes top <- d |> arrange(desc(value), desc(crashes)) |> head(10) data.frame( Road = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(top$road_full_name)), LGA = tools::toTitleCase(tolower(top$lga_name)), Crashes = top$crashes, KSI = top$ksi, Deaths = top$fatalities ) }, digits = 0) ## Third row: "When?" + "Who?" output$area_when_chart <- renderPlotly({ area_check() validate(need(nrow(area_user_data()) > 0, "No crashes match this selection")) d <- summarise_crashes(area_user_data(), by = input$area_when) when <- data.frame(when = d[[input$area_when]], value = scaled_value(d, input$area_measure, input$area_scale, NA)) plot_ly( when, x = ~when, y = ~value, type = "bar", marker = list(color = "#0d3b66"), hovertext = ~paste0(when_text(when, input$area_when), ": ", number_text(value, input$area_scale)), hovertemplate = paste0("%{hovertext} ", area_unit(), "") ) |> layout( xaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = names(when_choices)[when_choices == input$area_when]), yaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = area_label()) ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE) }) output$area_when_note <- renderText({ req(input$area_lga) # Months that appear more than once in the period make monthly counts uneven n_months <- length(seq(as.Date(input$area_months[1]), area_end(), by = "month")) uneven <- input$area_when == "month" && input$area_scale == "count" && n_months > 12 && n_months %% 12 != 0 if (uneven) "Note: Repeated months in the selected period have taller bars" }) outputOptions(output, "area_when_note", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE) # keep updating while hidden output$area_vulnerable_chart <- renderPlotly({ area_check() validate(need(input$area_road_user == "all", "Choose \"All road users\" in \"Show crashes involving\" to compare road users")) validate(need(nrow(area_data()) > 0, "No crashes match this selection")) d <- summarise_vulnerable(area_data()) who <- data.frame(road_user = d$road_user, value = scaled_value(d, input$area_measure, input$area_scale, NA)) all <- who$value[who$road_user == "All crashes"] plot_ly( who[who$road_user != "All crashes", ], x = ~value, y = ~road_user, type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = "#0d3b66"), hovertext = ~number_text(value, input$area_scale), hovertemplate = paste0("%{y}: %{hovertext} ", area_unit(), "") ) |> layout( title = list(text = paste0("All crashes: ", number_text(all, input$area_scale), " ", area_unit(), ""), x = 0.02, font = list(size = 14)), xaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = area_label()), yaxis = list(fixedrange = TRUE, title = "") ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE) }) } shinyApp(ui, server)

name: about.md
content:
#### How to use this app

**Victoria:** crashes across the state for the selected years, metric and scale. All charts and the map follow these selections.

**My area:** crashes in one or more local government areas (LGAs) for the selected months and road users, including the location of each crash on the map.

Maps can be zoomed and moved; hovering over an area or a crash shows a summary; clicking a crash shows its details.

#### Definitions

**Crash:** a road crash in which at least one person was injured or killed, as recorded by Victoria Police.

**KSI:** people killed or seriously injured.

**Per 1,000 crashes:** people killed or seriously injured (KSI), or killed (deaths), for every 1,000 crashes. It measures how severe crashes were.

**Per 100k residents:** yearly number of crashes, people killed or seriously injured (KSI), or deaths, for every 100,000 people living in the area.

**Compare with population growth:** option of the trend chart that shows the selected values and the population relative to the first selected year, set to 100. It compares crash trends with Victoria's strong population growth. It is not a standard road-safety measure.

#### Things to keep in mind

- Rates per resident include every crash within an area, including those involving visitors and through traffic.
- A lower rate per resident does not necessarily mean safer roads. Rates do not account for how much people drive and traffic fluxes.
- Roads with the most crashes are not necessarily the most dangerous. Busier roads have more crashes, and traffic volumes are not available in this analysis.
- Small areas and short periods have few crashes; their figures can vary considerably by chance.
- Crash numbers in 2020 and 2021 were affected by COVID-19 restrictions.
- Some crashes from late 2025 do not have a recorded location yet; these crashes count only in state-wide totals.
- Alpine resorts and islands not administered by a council are grouped as `Unincorporated Vic`. Their resident population is small compared with the number of visitors, and no rate is shown for them.

#### Future work

- **Updated data:** the app currently covers crashes up to December 2025. Future versions could update the data automatically and include the most recent crashes.
- **Traffic volumes:** a road with many crashes may simply be a road used by many cars. Adding the number of vehicles on each road would make it possible to compare roads fairly.

#### Data sources
